caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a fluted, round mold or bowl with grooves along its vertical sides. The exterior of the bowl is colored in a light brown or tan shade, and the interior is shaded with tones of purple, gray, and light blue, suggesting the surface is metallic or reflective. The top edge of the mold is a circular rim, and inside, there are several angular segments radiating from a central raised section with a simple five-petal motif or hole in the middle. There is also a small metal ring attached to the exterior near the top edge, which is affixed by a circular element. The background is plain, and the drawing is framed by a rectangular outline, with the object positioned slightly off-center and casting a light, textured shadow beneath it. The medium appears to be colored pencil or a similar technique, applied on a cream paper.
title: Cake Mold
